# Skazka Tours

> Skazka Tours is a private safari concierge in Nairobi, Kenya, founded in 2015. It runs safaris for one small party at a time, two to six guests, with the same guide for the whole trip and no fixed itineraries. The founder and lead guide is Kimani Kennedy Muna, a KPSGA silver-licensed guide and former electrical engineer. Guiding is in English, Swahili and Russian.

Last updated: November 2026. Everything below is stated on the pages of https://skazka.tours/.

## Key facts

- What: private, tailor-made safaris in Kenya, with concierge support from arrival to departure
- Who it suits: couples, families and close friends travelling as one party of two to six; never pooled with strangers
- Where: Maasai Mara conservancies, Laikipia, Samburu, Amboseli, Tsavo, Lamu and the Kenya coast
- Based in: Nairobi, Kenya; established 2015
- Team: 25 people (guides, chefs, mechanics, pilots), including a Russian-speaking manager, Elena
- Languages: English, Swahili, Russian
- Guests per year: fewer than 90
- Contact: hello@skazka.tours · WhatsApp +254 722 503 787 · https://skazka.tours/enquire/

## Price

- Sample journeys start from $6,800 per person for 5 days, $12,600 for 10 days and $16,200 for 14 days, based on sharing.
- Included: everything after landing. Camps and lodging, all meals, all transfers including charter flights where relevant, park and conservancy fees, the guide and crew, and the concierge.
- Not included: international flights and visas.
- Each trip is quoted in one clearly priced document with the reasoning for every choice.

## Sample journeys (starting points, not fixed packages)

- Mara Classic, our way — 10 days, private conservancies, night drives and a river camp, from $12,600 per person, shared
- Coast, craft & bush — 14 days, Tsavo, Lamu, Malindi, from $16,200 per person, shared
- The short sabbatical — 5 days, a private conservancy in Laikipia with three guided walks and a hot-air balloon at dawn, from $6,800 per person, shared

## How a trip is made

1. A conversation, typically 45 minutes by video.
2. A written draft route, delivered in 3–5 days, then revised until it feels right.
3. On the ground with the same guide every day, from arrival to departure.
4. Plans change daily when the trip calls for it. The itinerary is a starting hypothesis, not a contract.

## When to go

- Maasai Mara: best July to October (migration); late June is quieter
- Laikipia: all year
- Samburu: June to March
- Amboseli: June to October, and January to February
- Tsavo: June to October
- Lamu and the coast: best November to March

## A typical day (East Africa Time, UTC+3)

05:30 tea · 06:00 out for the dawn light · 10:00 breakfast in the bush · midday rest at camp · 15:30 out again until sunset (about 18:40) · dinner under the stars. There is no fixed day; plans are adjusted daily.

## Families and children

Children are welcome; guests as young as five have travelled. With children the pace is slower, driving hours are cut, and the trip leans into walks, camp projects and astronomy after dark.

## Booking

Six to twelve months ahead is comfortable. July to October is often full a year out. Small windows are held for last-minute guests. Every enquiry is read personally by Kimani, with a reply within two working days.

## House rules (the promises kept on every trip)

One guide for the whole trip. Small parties only. The itinerary is a hypothesis. Route around the storm instead of cancelling a day. Explain the land. Leave room to do nothing. Every enquiry read personally. Full text: https://skazka.tours/skazka.md
